title: Looking for a Cyrillic support patch for RM2K3

posts.author: soomeeoh
posts.body: Is there any working patch that adds Cyrillic support to RPG Maker 2003?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Maybe this is what you're looking for:
Patch for Cyrillic support in RPG Maker 2003
The modern versions of RPG Maker 2003 release added a lot of new features, but they don’t support Cyrillic.  This patch changes the RPG Maker 2003 1.12a to support Cyrillic: rm2k3-1-12a-patch-for-russian-support-v2.zip (1.7 Mb). Note that you will lose support for accented Latin characters (á...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
You're right, I accessed the Russian website and the creator of this patch either deleted their account or was banned.
In this case, the only solution would be to use the WayBack Machine website to see if the direct download works.
